# GMEOW GraphRAG Module

Pipeline observability for retrieval-augmented and GraphRAG systems (#54 facets A/B/F): the corpus, embedding, index, and retrieval substrate, and the derived entity-graph artifacts (extracted entities/relationships, communities, community summaries) — every artifact content-addressed, every step an attributed activity, so the derived graph is AUDITABLE and revisable rather than a black box (GraphRAG, arXiv:2404.16130). Claims extracted by the pipeline are the CORE ai slice's business (a StandpointClaim with model vantage); this extension carries the machinery around them. Vector payloads stay outside the graph by reference (P12).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/graphrag>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/graphrag`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Per-result epistemics (a retrieval's score for ONE chunk) ride RDF 1.2 statement annotations on the gmeow:retrievedChunk triple (gmeow:retrievalScore) — competing re-ranker scores coexist attributed, never overwritten (P9, P3).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/graphrag>
